guidance.summary: Advisory only: preserve structural-risk and exhaustion awareness while explicitly auditing each prior change_condition during the next observation window. Treat missed directional participation as informational; do not convert it into entry pressure, anti-abstention pressure, or quantity pressure.
consider: For each flat decision, state whether the declared change_condition was unmet, met and explicitly reassessed, or met without reassessment.
Keep the developing movement, favorable participation condition, invalidation, and later observed path separate from any hypothetical fill or PnL.
When a condition is met but immediate geometry remains poor, record the genuinely new contrary evidence rather than silently retaining the old thesis.
When daily_economics mirrors are present, note band position as observational context only; preservation vs pressing eval target is Hermes-owned and outcome_backed: false in seeds.
avoid: Do not infer counterfactual PnL, target/stop ordering, fills, or realized expectancy from OHLC excursions.
Do not activate or modify the proposed cognitive overlay from decision episodes alone.
Do not use the proportional daily objective as a quota, trade trigger, fixed risk amount, or sizing baseline.
Do not treat repeated missed participation classifications as proof that a deterministic entry rule is required.
